newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy restarts 90,200-bpd Mizushima topper.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy restarts 90,200-bpd Mizushima topper.

text.p: Refiner Japan Energy Corp said on Thursday it has restarted a 90,200 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at its Mizushima plant in Okayama prefecture in western Japan.
The topper had been closed since early April for routine maintenance work.
Secondary refining facilities that had been shut for maintenance checks also resumed operations except for a vacuum distillation unit, a Japan Energy spokesman said.
The 73,000-bpd vacuum distillation unit is scheduled to come back onstream on Friday, he said.
The Mizushima plant's other topper, with capacity of 110,000 bpd, will skip maintenance work this year.
